services.name: Whale Watching Tours
services.desc: We offer a Greater Seattle whale watching tours like no other in Seattle & San Juan Islands, Friday Harbor & Roche Harbor! Hop aboard your personal seaplane on a breathtaking flight to Friday Harbor on beautiful San Juan Island. We bring you to the doorstep of San Juan Island’s best whale watching. Your place awaits you as you enjoy a tour to remember. Seattle whale watching tours to Friday Harbor and Roche Harbor are made easy by a scenic 45 minute seaplane. Western Prince Whale & Wildlife tours features two fantastic options for the whale watching experience you will only get in the beautiful San Juan Islands. They offer two different tour options for you to choose from. Friday Harbor

services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Join our expert guides in the premiere Orca Whale waters! Sea Quest’s specialty is finding orca whales and marine wildlife while kayaking. We give you the best chance because our routes are chosen each day using the most recent reports to maximize your chances for a whale encounter! Our 40 years of living and working as biologists and educators in the San Juan Islands make us the top kayaking and wildlife experts! You may also see seals, sea lions, porpoises, otters, eagles and much more. Sea Quest was chosen for National Geographic’s “10 Best Trips in the World for 2011” and USA Today’s “World’s Top 10 Adventure Bargains.” Our sea kayaks are stable, safe and fun for all ages! blurb: Friday Harbor Seaplanes operates multiple daily scheduled seaplane flights from South Lake Washington (Renton Municipal Airport) to Friday Harbor, Roche Harbor, and Rosario Village on San Juan Island and Orcas Island. They provide shuttle service to and from Sea-Tac International Airport and free parking at their Renton terminal. Flights operate seasonally from May through early October.
